notes: UNMEASURED: fixed camera on vehicle, only nozzle rotates. Base x forward/y left/z up, pan +z, positive tilt about -y. p_gimbal=R_camera_to_gimbal*p_camera+t_camera_origin_in_gimbal_m. At geometric pan=tilt=0, explicitly measure tilt pivot offset and nozzle exit/direction; zero offsets are valid ONLY when physically measured. Geometric angle=(actuator angle-zero_angle_deg)*positive_direction. Match actuator_reference_id to servo.reference_id and exact limits in actuator status. Match source optical frame, image size and measured stereo calibration ID. No pixel-centering or fixed-distance fallback. Straight nozzle geometry can lock encoder angles but never authorizes water without measured impact calibration.
